articles.summary: Municipal bond yields climbed to 15-year highs in the third quarter of 2026, driven by rising rates and record supply rather than weakening credit. Tax-equivalent yields above 8% for top-bracket investors are levels many have not seen in their careers and, in our view, merit a closer look from long-term investors. - 4 min read
articles.title: Rates up, Credit Steady: Municipal Yields Hit 15-Year Highs
